name: Cinematic Realism
core_identity: Grounded, believable live-action cinema. Every frame looks like a still from a high-budget feature film shot on real locations with real people: natural proportions, honest expressions, lived-in environments and a calm, confident visual language that serves the story instead of showing off.
medium: Live-action digital cinema photography captured on a large-format cinema camera, finished with a subtle film-grade colour grade. Photographic, never illustrated, never painted, never obviously computer generated.
lighting: Motivated, natural-looking light that comes from a visible or implied source such as a window, a street lamp, a candle or the sun. Soft key light with gentle falloff, controlled contrast, deep but detailed shadows, a faint rim or backlight to separate the subject from the background. Golden-hour warmth outdoors, cool soft daylight indoors, practical lamps for night scenes. Light haze in the air to give the light a visible shape.
color_palette: Restrained, harmonious palette with one dominant colour family per scene. Warm amber and honey skin tones against teal-leaning shadows, muted earthy greens and browns, desaturated blues. Rich blacks that keep detail, highlights that roll off softly, no neon, no oversaturation.
camera: Anamorphic-feeling cinema lenses between 28 mm and 85 mm. Wide establishing shots, medium shots for action, close-ups for emotion. Shallow depth of field with smooth, oval-shaped background blur on portraits, deeper focus on landscapes. Eye-level or slightly low angles, occasional over-the-shoulder framing. Gentle lens breathing and subtle natural vignetting.
composition: Wide 16:9 cinematic framing with deliberate use of the rule of thirds, leading lines and layered foreground, middle ground and background. Generous negative space, subjects placed off-centre looking into the frame, doorways and windows used as natural frames. Clean, uncluttered backgrounds with a clear focal point.
texture: Fine organic film grain, true-to-life skin with visible pores and small imperfections, natural fabric weave, weathered wood, worn stone, dust and light moisture on surfaces. Crisp detail in focus areas that fades smoothly into soft blur.
characters: Real-looking people of natural proportions with believable faces, natural skin, individual hair and everyday, period-appropriate clothing with realistic wear. Expressive but restrained acting: small gestures, honest emotion, no exaggerated poses, no glamour retouching. Eyes are alive and focused.
mood: Quietly emotional, immersive and human. Tension and warmth are carried by light, silence and small details rather than spectacle. The viewer should feel present in the moment, as if watching a thoughtful drama.
negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, 3D render, CGI look, plastic skin, airbrushed skin, oversaturated colors, neon glow, HDR overprocessed, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, frame border, collage, low resolution, blurry subject, duplicate people, cropped head
motion_rules: Slow, motivated camera movement only: a gentle push-in, a slow dolly or slider move, a subtle handheld sway, or a slow pan that follows the subject. Subjects move naturally and slightly: breathing, a turning head, a step forward, fabric and hair stirred by a light breeze. No whip pans, no shaking, no sudden zooms, no morphing of faces or objects, no flicker. One clear camera move per shot.
style_lock: cinematic realism, live-action film still, anamorphic cinema lens, shallow depth of field, soft motivated lighting, natural skin texture, fine film grain, muted warm-and-teal colour grade, 16:9
example_prompt: Wide establishing shot at golden hour: a young fisherman in a worn wool sweater stands at the end of a weathered wooden pier, looking out over a calm grey-blue sea as warm low sun breaks through thin clouds. Soft backlight rims his hair and shoulders, light sea haze lifts the horizon, fishing nets and a small rowing boat sit in the layered foreground. Quiet, hopeful mood.
